entries.title: A held batch keeps its changes when only their tests are out of date
entries.body: On a project with batched pull requests, the crewmate repairing a held batch now fixes it forward by default once it has found the cause. When a change works as intended but left a test, its data or a generated file out of date, the repair updates them in its own fix, so the change stays in its batch instead of waiting for a later one. A change goes back to its crewmate only when its own code needs to change, the fix needs a decision, or the fix is not small.
entries.noPicture: This changes how a held batch's repair answers; no screen looks different.
